test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-4) Official paper (Held On: 10 May 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Tehri Dam built on the river Bhagirathi is situated in which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttarakhand**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Tehri Dam**

 
 
• The tallest dam in India is the Tehri dam built across the **Bhagirathi River.**
 
• The Tehri Dam is the **highest dam in India and one of the highest in the world**.
 
• It is a multi-purpose rock and earth-fill embankment dam in **Uttarakhand, India**
